title: ACM Problem-Solving Platform
description: A website designed to help users solve ACM programming problems efficiently.

features.name: Problem Repository
features.description: A comprehensive collection of ACM programming problems categorized by difficulty and topic.

features.name: Code Submission System
features.description: Allows users to submit their code and receive instant feedback on correctness and performance.

features.name: User Profiles
features.description: Enables users to create profiles to track their progress and achievements.

features.name: Leaderboard
features.description: Displays rankings based on user performance and problem-solving activity.

features.name: Tutorials and Hints
features.description: Provides educational resources and hints to help users understand and solve problems.

target_users: Students, competitive programmers, and individuals preparing for ACM contests
data_requirements: Storage for user profiles, problem data, code submissions, and leaderboard information
